items.text:
Ostranauts has some promise, but the implementation leaves much to be desired. I loved its retro aesthetic and was looking forward to trying it out.  It's clear the developers are working for a "gritty" kind of experience, and it feels like it doesn't get there, and instead veers off into just "frustrating".

I like games that don't hold your hand, but Ostranauts goes to incredible lengths to be hard to understand. The user interface is slow, clumsy and counter-intuitive, and I felt like I was constantly fighting the UI. It's also clear the game wants to be "hard" in that it's difficult to achieve success- but it does that by simply throwing extremely frustrating and arbitrary obstacles in your path as opposed to adding challenging but reasonably obtainable goals to the gameplay.

For example: the in-game "police" can board your ship and issue you fines, which you have to pay before leaving the station next. But because the fines can be so large, you can't undock or do anything. In theory, there's a way to talk to an NPC that can let you undock, but if you can't figure out the bizarre conversation system, or you're just not lucky enough to get a successful roll on a conversational "gambit", he just tells you to get bent.

So you can end up stuck and locked into the station with no path forward to access the primary gameplay loop. Instead I was faced with possibly wandering around the station for who knows how long- and because navigating the station is also slow, clumsy and frustrating, that was not something I wanted to try- hoping to stumble into a possible solution.

The gameplay isn't challenging, it's just punishing and frustrating, and isn't fun. I really wanted it to be.
items.text_zh:
《Ostranauts》有一些潜力，但实现方面还有很多不足之处。我喜欢它的复古美学，并期待尝试一下。很明显，开发者们正在努力营造一种“粗粝”的体验，但感觉并没有达到那个效果，反而转向了单纯的“令人沮丧”。

我喜欢不手把手教你的游戏，但《Ostranauts》为了让人难以理解而费尽心机。用户界面缓慢、笨拙且反直觉，我感觉自己一直在和UI作斗争。同样明显的是，游戏想要“难”，即难以取得成功——但它是通过在你前进的道路上简单地抛出极其令人沮丧和随意的障碍来实现的，而不是在游戏玩法中添加具有挑战性但合理可达成的目标。

例如：游戏中的“警察”可以登上你的飞船并给你开罚单，你必须在下次离开空间站之前支付。但由于罚款可能非常高，你无法脱离对接或做任何事情。理论上，有一种方法可以与一个NPC交谈，让他允许你脱离对接，但如果你搞不懂那套奇怪的对话系统，或者你只是运气不好，没有在对话“策略”中掷出成功，他就只会叫你滚蛋。

所以你最终可能会被困在空间站里，无法进入主要游戏循环。相反，我面临的是可能在空间站里漫无目的地游荡不知道多久——而且因为空间站内的导航也同样缓慢、笨拙且令人沮丧，那不是我想要尝试的事情——指望着偶然撞见一个可能的解决方案。

游戏玩法并不具有挑战性，它只是惩罚性和令人沮丧的，而且不好玩。我真的很希望它好玩。
